{{Top|notoc=1}}
Many [[Species/Legends|species]] had [[Exoskeleton|external shells]] made of '''chitin'''. These included the [[Sauvax]],<ref name="Leritor">{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}</ref> the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]],<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]],<ref name="TLAOTH">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref> and numerous types of [[Killik/Legends|Killik]].<ref name="Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

Some insectoid species could shed their chitin-based exoskeleton in order to grow or heal themselves.<ref name="TLAOTH" />
